primary_outcome.engine: Use the exact existing AE2 outcome engine and horizon; do not alter during validation.
primary_outcome.both_same_bar: Track separately; exclude from primary binary FF denominator.
primary_outcome.unresolved: Track separately; exclude from primary binary FF denominator until resolved under the frozen existing outcome engine.

NEUTRAL.definition: Valid AE2 with neither promoted positive family nor any promoted negative family.

N2_NO_CLEARANCE_WEAKNESS: OR session_level_clear_state == NONE_CLEARED AND relative_multi_horizon_state == RELATIVE_ALIGNED

overlap_rules.H1B: ALL_3_CLEARED + ALL_3_OPPOSING is supporting evidence nested inside P1; no second positive vote.
overlap_rules.N2: The two N2 child rules count as one negative family.
overlap_rules.positive_negative_conflict: Historical development set had none. If one appears prospectively, classify AVOID and flag MODEL_CONFLICT for audit; do not change the model.

feature_source_policy.session_levels: Use exact existing feature-generation implementation for PMH/PML, prior AH high/low, and PDH/PDL; do not re-derive with changed session boundaries.
feature_source_policy.market_features: Use exact existing frozen 5D consensus and 3-index state implementations.
feature_source_policy.relative_strength: Use exact existing frozen relative_multi_horizon_state implementation.
feature_source_policy.exhaustion: Use exact existing frozen exhaustion_state implementation.
feature_source_policy.no_post_entry_leakage: No C3+, MFE/MAE, Trade Health, recovery, or warning information may affect entry-state classification.

prospective_sample_plan.stop_rule: Do not stop early because results look favorable. Formal graduation review begins only when all minimums are met.

primary: PREFERRED favorable-first pct > NEUTRAL favorable-first pct
NEUTRAL favorable-first pct > AVOID favorable-first pct
directional: Within BULL, PREFERRED > AVOID by >= 3.0 pp once directional minimum N is met
Within BEAR, PREFERRED > AVOID by >= 3.0 pp once directional minimum N is met
robustness: No single symbol contributes > 5% of PREFERRED prospective events at graduation
Top-10 symbols contribute <= 35% of PREFERRED prospective events at graduation
Report monthly and quarterly state ordering without changing rules in response
success_criteria.interpretation: Passing criteria supports continued validation/production candidacy; it does not guarantee profitability or justify untested execution rules.

change_control.rule: No changes to AE2 definition, state logic, thresholds, sessions, outcome engine, or feature formulas during V1 prospective validation.
change_control.if_change_needed: Freeze V1 results, create ALT_C2_CANDIDATE_MODEL_V2, document exact change and rationale, and start a new prospective validation cycle.

required: overall state counts and binary counts
